scores.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`, as well as wrong TypeScript interface names). It completely missed the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config and the new `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` code, leaving the feature always enabled by default. Furthermore, when a store does not implement `listFor`, the candidate returns an empty array `{sessions: []}` instead of an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame, explicitly violating a core requirement and acceptance criterion of the issue. Validation also fails to enforce the `1-200` range on `limit` (accepting 0 or >200), the store error handler logs raw store error messages which the issue forbade for security/GDPR reasons, and required updates to `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md` were omitted.
